content.text: The passage is a collage of unrelated texts: Anglican discussions of Scripture, Prayer Book doctrine, Sacraments, Baptism, Communion, Confirmation, Marriage, Orders, Penance, and Unction; Pepys’s diary of London office work, taverns, theatres, family affairs, journeys to Brampton and Cambridge, and visits to Whitehall, the Wardrobe, churches, and friends; poems and fiction; and scientific articles on lime kilns, apple-jelly manufacture, grape bags, solar heat, surveying, pheasants, trees, and American woods. It includes many movements between specific places, including kitchens, bedrooms, churches, offices, taverns, theatres, gardens, boats, London districts, Brampton, Cambridge, and rural estates.
